errors.description: The displayed cardinality bound has an off-by-one error: since D\{p} has |D|-1 primes, only 2^{|D|-1}≤w(D\{p}) follows. This is readily repaired and still yields a uniform bound on |D|, so the finiteness argument remains valid.

parsed.notes: Apart from this minor inequality error, the scan interpretation, self-duality, sunflower lemma, weight descent, finiteness of minimal supports, and final periodicity argument are coherent and complete.
